objective: Close the CW-10 production worker-response boundary so TaskWorkflow obtains decisions only from strict public OMP events, never test provider private state.
required_behavior: Inject a production response contract for worker TASK stage=execute and QUESTION stage=analysis using exact delivery identities; do not depend on WORKBENCH_G3_EXPECTED_RESPONSE_MARKER.

At public OMP message_end parse exactly one full marker-framed flat JSON object with exact allowlisted keys, canonical UUIDs, positive safe revision, matching stage/kind/identity, allowed decision, stopReason=stop, no error or tool content; never publish raw text.

Reject malformed, unknown/duplicate keys, prefix/suffix prose, multiple markers/objects, duplicate/conflicting responses, retry/additional provider round, error/abort/tool/continuation/session switch/pause/disconnect with fixed reason codes only.

Settle the validated candidate only at terminal agent_end where willContinue is not true and current delivery/session/generation/provider evidence still matches; publish assistant_message_end with allowlisted workerResponse, then delivery_omp_processed linked by response ID.

Implement and export a production G3WorkerResponsePort in worker_port.py that uses only G3BridgeServer public events, exact receipt/message correlation, strict types, common deadline, one arm/observe, and no replay/private provider object.
Replace actual OMP workflow probes' test-only provider response adapters/private response dictionary reads with G3WorkerResponsePort. Preserve privacy and all existing authority/identity guards.
required_tests: Node and Python unit tests for all strict parsing/correlation/fail-closed invariants and no raw content leakage.
Actual OMP 18.2.10 two-response vertical probe using production adapter only and no provider private state.
Full workflow, bridge, G3, task, terminal regressions; secret/residue and git diff checks.
constraints: Use apply_patch for edits. Do not edit docs, requirements, PLAN/state, workflow artifacts, graphify, dependencies, or unrelated files.
Do not weaken general delivery_omp_processed semantics; malformed decision may coexist with processed delivery but must never authorize workflow execution/report.
No raw model/user content in public events or durable artifacts.
No commit/push/merge/stash/reset/clean. Run graphify update . after code/test changes and report generated drift separately.
report: pre/post proof that no private provider state is used
